Subject: Request: AWS co-sell warm intro & joint account plan for Orbital Health

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the quick product walkthrough last week. Orbital Health’s use of large models for chart summarization and clinical search looks like a strong fit for Redwood’s AWS marketplace + co-sell motion.

As discussed offline, our AWS Partner SA has asked for a short warm intro so we can align on:
- mutual action plan and milestones for a pilot (60–90 days)
- technical owners and security gates (SOC2 / data flow)
- procurement timeline and commercial path (marketplace listing vs direct commit)

Could you confirm who from Orbital should join an initial 30–45 minute alignment call? Suggested attendees on our side: Karthik (Solutions), Laura (Marketplace ops), and me (AE).

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Aug 15, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Aug 16, 1:00–1:45pm
- Thu Aug 17, 11:00–11:45am

If none of those work, share 2 windows that do and we’ll coordinate with AWS. I’ve started a draft Mutual Action Plan in the shared Drive; I’ll drop the link once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine —

Tue Aug 15 at 10am PST works for us. I’ll invite Ravi (VP Product) and Arjun (Head of Infra) to the call. High level asks from our side:
- confirmation that marketplace deployment will support VPC/private subnets (on-prem-like controls)
- short SLA/uptime expectations for pilot traffic

I can share our procurement lead if we want them on the call but for the first alignment meeting we’ll keep it to product/infra + your team.

See you Tuesday.
